output.summary: A small evergreen tree native to the American tropics. Its flowers grow in clusters directly on the trunk and older branches, while yellow-to-orange pods hold numerous seeds in white pulp. Dried, fermented seeds make cocoa and chocolate; the pulp is also used for drinks, jelly and cream.
output.edibilityNote: Dried, fermented seeds make cocoa and chocolate; pulp is used for juice, smoothies, jelly, cream and sometimes fermented alcoholic drinks.
